title: Smoke Test — Event Reconciliation widget
subtitle: Dashboard widget: gross − refunds − comps + donations, with a per-channel breakdown and manually-entered, persisted processing fees.

meta.Flow: Login → event dashboard → Event Reconciliation widget → edit + save a channel fee

steps.title: Dashboard loads
steps.description: Event dashboard top — existing stat boxes and charts unaffected; the new widget is appended below.

steps.title: Event Reconciliation card
steps.description: Three headline tiles (Net Expected Funds $395, Collected to date $395 with progress bar, Net to bank $385.90) and the waterfall: Gross $415 − Refunds $20 − Comps $25 + Donations $25 = $395, then − Processing fees $9.10 = Net to bank $385.90.
steps.notes: Headline math matches the backend unit test exactly (net expected = 19250-style waterfall, here 415 − 20 − 25 + 25 = 395).

steps.title: Funds by Channel card
steps.description: Per-channel rows (Stripe / Square / Cash / Check) with sales, donations, refunds, an editable fee, net deposit and share. Colored channel dots; Stripe & Square fees editable, Cash & Check disabled (no processing fee). Totals reconcile to $385.90 net deposit; comps shown in the non-cash footer.

steps.title: Edit a channel fee (dirty state)
steps.description: Changing the Stripe fee from $6.20 to $7.50 enables the Save button.

steps.title: Save fee — persisted & recomputed
steps.description: Save fires the PATCH; success toast 'Processing fees saved'. Stripe net recomputes to $187.50, totals fee to $10.40 and net deposit to $384.60 — confirming the full round-trip (edit → persist → reconcile → re-render).
